source: Original processed common-training pool (not bundled); see manifests and README
selection: fixed final epoch; no held-out checkpoint selection
split: entire primitive multisets withheld; any-role stereo-free molecule overlap and evidence IDs removed from training
exclusions: unsupported primitives reported, excluded only from supported-combination estimand
scope: retrospective cross-validation within historical training pool, not new independent external evidence
pair_controls: unrecorded compatible pairs; not verified biological negatives
retrieval: not refitted; previous fold-specific retrieval unchanged
